topic: Day 15 — carousel — The chapter you'll be grateful for is probably the hardest one right now

slides.text: People rarely look back fondly on the easy stretches.
The proudest periods are almost always the hard ones.
Meaning attaches to struggle, not to comfort.
You might be proud of [this] one day.

caption:
People rarely look back fondly on the easy stretches. The chapters they're proudest of are almost always the ones that felt unbearable at the time.

Follow for one of these a day.
